title: Dashboard Structure Repair
summary: Repairs the grouped navigation regression, makes DashboardShell the canonical layout owner, normalizes desktop scale, and rebuilds empty operational states so feature pages no longer look visually fragmented.

sections.title: Shell and navigation
items: DashboardShell is now the explicit dashboard layout owner instead of leaving the legacy dashboard layout in the active tree.
Fixed grouped navigation links so icons and labels render as one horizontal row with a consistent active indicator.
Raised the desktop collapse breakpoint so normal 1440p/1080p desktop layouts keep the full sidebar instead of switching to a compressed tablet rail too early.
Improved desktop typography, control sizing, spacing and light/dark surface contrast.

sections.title: Feature pages
items: Converted legacy artwork-heavy feature headers into compact operational page toolbars with actions aligned consistently.
Port Battles now uses a useful empty workspace when nothing is scheduled instead of showing a tiny schedule/select-battle strip in a large empty canvas.
Port Battle schedule rows, selection states, buttons and roster surfaces were resized for normal desktop readability.
The repair is presentation-only and does not change Port Battle, Membership, Wiki, Sentinel or Music API contracts.
